name: Can I convert an existing vanity into an accessible one?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert an existing vanity into an accessible one?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting an existing vanity into an accessible one is sometimes possible but depends heavily on its current design and construction. For instance, if the vanity is a console style or has open space underneath, it might be adaptable with height adjustments or replacing cabinetry with an open design. However, if it's a standard cabinet-style vanity, creating sufficient knee clearance often requires significant modification, potentially involving structural changes or custom fabrication. Often, replacing it with a purpose-built accessible vanity is more straightforward and cost-effective.
acceptedAnswer.description: Conversion depends on the existing vanity's design; open-style vanities are more adaptable. Standard cabinet vanities often require significant modification, making replacement a more straightforward option.
